content:
I am excited to share with you all that, I have been promoted to Assistant Team Lead at EXO Edge 
 
It’s truly rewarding when your hard work pays off and is recognized. Even better when your organization values your dedication.

I sincerely express my special gratitude to Tejinder Kawatra Ritu G. Aman Mehraa Priyanka Yadav for believing in me consistently, inspiring me to grow, and making this achievement possible.

I would also like to thank Neelesh Pratap Singh Kiran Kumar Shalabh Shankhdhar Monika Sharma Sonali Negi Geetika Sharma for your mentorship and support.

comment: A promotion also marks a shift from delivering individual results to enabling others to succeed. The ability to mentor, delegate, and build trust often becomes the real measure of leadership growth.
